queries.name: VL clients by province
queries.sql:
with zm_ids as (
  select a.lab_request_id,
    max(case when a.code = 'reference-numbers' then a.value_text end) as reference_numbers,
    max(case when a.code = 'unique-id' then a.value_text end) as unique_id
  from lab_request_attributes a
  where a.system = 'urn:openldr:cs:request-attribute' and a.code in ('reference-numbers', 'unique-id')
  group by a.lab_request_id
),
zm_req as (
  select lr.id, lr.request_id, lr.panel_code, lr.age_years, lr.authored_at,
    fmr.region as province, fmr.district, fmr.name as facility,
    concat(p.firstname, ' ', p.surname) as client_name,
    case p.sex when 'F' then 'Female' when 'M' then 'Male' when 'U' then 'Unknown' when 'I' then 'Indeterminate' else 'Missing' end as gender,
    zi.reference_numbers, zi.unique_id,
    dr.status as report_status, dr.effective as collected_date, dr.issued as result_date
  from lab_requests lr
  join facility_map fmr on fmr.source_system = coalesce(lr.source_system, '') and fmr.performer_system = coalesce(lr.requester_system, '') and fmr.source_code = lr.requester_code and fmr.registry_id is not null
  left join diagnostic_reports dr on dr.based_on_id = lr.id
  left join patients p on p.id = lr.patient_id
  left join zm_ids zi on zi.lab_request_id = lr.id
  where ({{param.province}} = '' or fmr.region = {{param.province}})
    and lr.panel_code in ('HIVVL', 'RTRI')
    and (dr.issued >= {{param.from}} and dr.issued <= ({{param.to}} || 'T23:59:59.999Z') or lr.authored_at >= {{param.from}} and lr.authored_at <= ({{param.to}} || 'T23:59:59.999Z'))
),
zm_valid as (
  select q.province, q.district, q.facility, q.request_id as lab_id, q.client_name, q.age_years, q.gender,
    case
    when coalesce(q.reference_numbers, '') ilike ',ELABS%' then right(coalesce(q.reference_numbers, ''), greatest(length(rtrim(coalesce(q.reference_numbers, ''))) - strpos(upper(coalesce(q.reference_numbers, '')), 'T.') - 1, 0))
    when coalesce(q.reference_numbers, '') ilike '%,ELABS%' then right(left(coalesce(q.reference_numbers, ''), strpos(lower(coalesce(q.reference_numbers, '')), ',elabs') - 1), greatest(length(rtrim(left(coalesce(q.reference_numbers, ''), strpos(lower(coalesce(q.reference_numbers, '')), ',elabs') - 1))) - 3, 0))
    when replace(replace(regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(q.reference_numbers, ''), ',', ''), 'AT\.', '', 'gi'), ' ', ''), '-', '') = '' then replace(replace(coalesce(q.unique_id, ''), ' ', ''), '-', '')
    when regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(q.reference_numbers, ''), ',', ''), 'AT\.', '', 'gi') ilike 'ART.%' or regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(q.reference_numbers, ''), ',', ''), 'AT\.', '', 'gi') ilike 'ELABS.%' then replace(replace(coalesce(q.unique_id, ''), ' ', ''), '-', '')
    else replace(replace(regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(q.reference_numbers, ''), ',', ''), 'AT\.', '', 'gi'), ' ', ''), '-', '')
  end as art_number,
    q.collected_date, q.authored_at as registered_date, q.result_date,
    coalesce(r.text_value, coalesce(r.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || r.numeric_value::text, r.coded_value) as result,
    case when lower(rtrim(coalesce(r.text_value, coalesce(r.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || r.numeric_value::text, r.coded_value))) in ('<20 copies/ml', 'tar', 'target not detected', 'targ', '< 20', 'rna not detected', '<30 copies/ml', '<30 copies/ml', 'ndet', 'nd', '<20cp', '< 40', '<40 copies/ml', '<400 copies/ml', '<400', '<883 copies/ml') or r.numeric_value < 1000 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as suppressed
  from zm_req q
  join lab_results r on r.request_id = q.id
  where q.panel_code in ('HIVVL', 'RTRI')
    and r.observation_code in ('HIVVL', 'HIVVC', 'HIVTM', 'HIVVD', 'POCVR', 'POCVC')
    and q.report_status = 'final'
    and q.result_date >= {{param.from}} and q.result_date <= ({{param.to}} || 'T23:59:59.999Z')
    and coalesce(r.text_value, coalesce(r.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || r.numeric_value::text, r.coded_value) is not null
    and not lower(rtrim(coalesce(r.text_value, coalesce(r.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || r.numeric_value::text, r.coded_value))) in ('antibodies. @mat3', 'fail', 'haemolysed', 'haemolysed ++', 'insufficient for further tests', 'insufficient serum received', 'inv', 'inval', 'negative', 'no', 'please repeat', 'positive', 'to confirm patient identity.', 'weak positive', 'invalid', 'absent', 'antibodies.', 'at', 'failed', 'icteric ++++', 'indeterminate', 'per request', 'positive (repeat sample)', 'this result has been checked', 'val', '@con1 @con2')
),
zm_rejected as (
  select q.province, q.district, q.facility, q.request_id as lab_id, q.client_name, q.age_years, q.gender,
    q.unique_id as art_number, q.collected_date, q.authored_at as registered_date, q.result_date,
    'REJECTED' as result, null::text as suppressed
  from zm_req q
  where q.panel_code = 'HIVVL'
    and q.report_status = 'cancelled'
    and q.authored_at >= {{param.from}} and q.authored_at <= ({{param.to}} || 'T23:59:59.999Z')
    and not exists (select 1 from zm_valid v where v.lab_id = q.request_id)
),
zm_unclear as (
  select q.province, q.district, q.facility, q.request_id as lab_id, q.client_name, q.age_years, q.gender,
    q.unique_id as art_number, q.collected_date, q.authored_at as registered_date, q.result_date,
    coalesce(r.text_value, coalesce(r.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || r.numeric_value::text, r.coded_value) as result, null::text as suppressed
  from zm_req q
  join lab_results r on r.request_id = q.id
  where q.panel_code = 'HIVVL'
    and r.observation_code in ('HIVVL', 'HIVVC', 'HIVVD')
    and q.report_status = 'final'
    and q.result_date >= {{param.from}} and q.result_date <= ({{param.to}} || 'T23:59:59.999Z')
    and coalesce(r.text_value, coalesce(r.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || r.numeric_value::text, r.coded_value) is not null
    and not coalesce(coalesce(r.text_value, coalesce(r.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || r.numeric_value::text, r.coded_value) ~ '^\s*[-+]?[$£€¥]?(\d[\d,]*(\.\d*)?|\.\d+)([eE][-+]?\d+)?\s*$', false)
    and not lower(rtrim(coalesce(r.text_value, coalesce(r.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || r.numeric_value::text, r.coded_value))) in ('< 20', '<30 copies/ml', '> 10000000', 'ndet', 'target not detected', 'rna not detected', '<400 copies/ml', '<400', '<40 copies/ml')
    and not exists (select 1 from zm_valid v where v.lab_id = q.request_id)
)
select province as "Province", district as "District", facility as "Facility", lab_id as "LabID",
  client_name as "Name", age_years as "AgeInYears", gender as "Gender", art_number as "ARTNumber",
  collected_date as "CollectedDate", registered_date as "RegisteredDate", result_date as "ResultDate",
  result as "Result", suppressed as "Suppressed"
from (
  select * from zm_valid
  union
  select * from zm_rejected
  union
  select * from zm_unclear
) zm
order by 1, 2, 3, 4, 11, 12, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 13
